Literal enumeration and polynomial identities were checked with the package verifier for n<=25, but the infinite proof is symbolic.

value.rationale: The channel is the short-fragment composition model used for polymer readout. This determines the optimal number of noiseless distinguishable weight-two messages and every ambiguity fiber for arbitrary finite length and read limit, plus an exact sharp saturation boundary; for fixed r the capacity remains r(3r-1)/2 despite arbitrarily long strands. Weight two is the first structurally nontrivial sparse source class and the result is not just a renamed known count.
